sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): a light quick run, the golden gauntlet swinging on his near arm, the jacket flapping, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as written for each frame
sheets.weapons: THE GOLDEN GAUNTLET goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): on his near hand, as big as in image 1, the blue gem on its back - raised at his chest, thrust out, held low or raised overhead, as the pale figure has it; his far hand bare. Only him: no bolts, no arcane light, no glow on the gauntlet, no blink sparks.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under his hips, his brown boot flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind him, its foot off the ground. Frame 2: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the near leg still planted under his hips, bending; the far leg swinging down from behind, its foot low, just off the ground behind the planted one. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must show a different leg planted. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all 8 frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the head, the arms and the gauntlet follow the pale figure.
